bullets.text: A powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake has killed at least 47 people in Indonesia, with search and rescue operations underway on the island of Flores.
Moroccan authorities have detained dozens of migrants attempting to cross into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, amidst heightened security.
Eleven people have been killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, which Israel's military stated were in response to earlier actions against its soldiers.

Australia is set to launch its largest gun buyback program in decades in New South Wales, following a funding agreement between the state and federal governments. The scheme, announced after a terror attack at Bondi beach, will begin in November.
A new housing project aims to provide secure rental accommodation for domestic violence survivors, offering a safe place for families who often flee with minimal belongings.

A One Nation senator has controversially stated that parents who support their transgender children are engaging in 'child abuse,' claiming 'There’s male, there’s female, and then there’s mental illness.'
OpenAI is reportedly preparing for an IPO amidst executive departures and safety team changes, causing internal unsettlement as the ChatGPT maker moves towards a blockbuster listing.
Bally’s Corp. has warned investors about “substantial doubt” regarding its ability to continue as a going concern, as the company risks breaching agreements with lenders while seeking new funds.
The world's biggest carry trader, Japan, has begun to exit its position by buying yen, unwinding a potentially dangerous trade.
